sentences.show: Hungry women marched on a palace, and brought the king back with them.
It began on this day in 1789, in the markets of Paris.
Bread cost nearly half a worker's income, and there wasn't enough.
A young woman beat a drum. Market women grabbed kitchen knives.
They stormed the city hall, for bread and for weapons.
Then thousands marched to Versailles, dragging cannons through the rain.
The king met six of the women, and promised food.
Most of the crowd didn't believe him.
At dawn, rioters broke into the palace, hunting for the queen's bedroom.
Marie Antoinette ran barefoot to the king's room, and escaped.
The crowd wanted one thing: the king must come to Paris.
60,000 people took the royal family back, with loaves of bread on their bayonets.
In Paris, the king asked for a book: the history of Charles I of England.
An English king who was beheaded.
